## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Silla bodhisattva-precept treatise by **Wǒnhyo** 元曉 ([元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89), 617–686), the foundational Korean Buddhist philosopher. Author signature: *新羅國沙門元曉述* (*Composed by the Silla monk Wǒnhyo*).

**Abstract**

The *Chífàn yàojì* is one of Wǒnhyo's most distinctive Vinaya works and presents his programmatic *intentionality-centred* analysis of the bodhisattva precepts: outer compliance is not sufficient; the precepts are *kept* and *violated* fundamentally at the level of inner intention (*xīn* 心) and contextual interpretation. The work is closely related to Wǒnhyo's broader *bodhisattva-bhūmi* commentarial programme and, alongside [KR6k0197](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0197) *Dàshèng liùqíng chànhuǐ* on Mahāyāna repentance, represents his contribution to the ethical-meditational integration of Mahāyāna practice. Composition belongs to Wǒnhyo's mature productive period after his famous turn-back from the Tang pilgrimage with Ǔisang 義湘.
